places-roca-de-marta-abric-del-mas-de-ba.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-roca-de-marta-abric-del-mas-de-ba.story: From Mequinensa / Mequinenza it runs 166 km to Mequinensa / Mequinenza; allow about 2 h 52 of riding. On the way it passes Val de mamet I, Abrigo del Plano del Pulido, Abric del mas de Barberà and back through Abrigo del Plano del Pulido. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Ronda and White Villages Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 18 km this is Ronda and White Villages Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
